items.title: Isaiah Morgan Interview, 1958-12-01
items.q: He's Warren. He played just like oil. And he can play that new style, and old style, all that. And as far as you can think, he's right there with you.

ctx.x: Did you ever make any other records afterwards? Uh-uh.

Well, I had a chance to make records, but look what I was doing. But look where I had to go to make them. That was in- They want me to go to Johnson, Tennessee. And I didn't want to go up there, you see. Because you can't pick them on no fellas around there. The fellas are hard, man. To get them to go anywhere, to round them, but they're around here with the not complicated, watching old ladies or something. They ain't scared to leave home. Yeah.
